Chapter 7014: Heavencrush Again

Chapter 7014: Heavencrush Again

The other immortals of this race had unique appearances. However, the majority was made from rocks and stones. Bronze was rarely seen.

“Brother, our little ones are in the wrong, so they will apologize.” Immortal Bronze said.

This displayed enough sincerity and decisiveness without dwelling on the details. This could easily put an end to the conflict.

“Buzz.” The sky turned dark due to a complex and colossal machine hovering above.

“Heavencrush.” Xialou Tingyue stared carefully at it.

Heavencrush rarely appeared in the past. Nevertheless, people were aware of its existence. Recently, it became renowned for appearing in Heavenfall Path and broke through the biggest seal, revealing the celestial source.

No one else made it to that forgotten area before it was too late. Now, the crowd became dejected upon seeing the machine.

It ignored everything and shot out red lasers, seemingly scanning the ancestral ground.

“The celestial source might actually be down there.” An immortal said.

“Brother, if there is a treasure, would you like to have a piece?” Immortal Bronze said generously.

“I prefer to see your techniques instead.” Xiaolou Tingyue said.

This caught Immortal Bronze by surprise.

“If you wish to fight, it can wait for another day.” Something ashen blotted out the sky. These particles couldn’t be seen but were certainly everywhere.

“What is this?” The crowd was creeped out since these gray particles could enter their body.

Therefore, immortals activated their auras to prevent the particles from getting close.

“Ash-serpent, no need to act all mysterious.” Xiaolou Tingyue’s sharp gaze instantly swept through the particles.

They came together in the form of a gray storm. Although it purposely restrained itself to the minimum, the world still creaked and moaned at its arrival. If fully unleashed, everything would be torn apart in just a short time.

“Ash-serpent.” An immortal’s expression changed drastically.

“From Vagabond Alliance.” Others have heard of this immortal before.
